title: Skull Ritual
description: A white line-art human skull floats in the upper center, vomiting a torrent of colorful paint splashes and swirling vortex patterns toward the left. Below right, a dark mound of earth or ashes supports a surreal insect-like creature wearing a wide-brimmed hat adorned with glowing yellow eyes.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork on black background featuring a detailed white skull floating in the upper portion, violently expelling swirling vortex patterns and vibrant magenta, cyan, yellow and white paint splatters from its mouth. In the lower right, a grotesque insectoid creature with multiple eyes and a wide hat sits atop a textured black mound. Energetic paint drips and bokeh light circles in the background, high contrast, ritualistic atmosphere.
